notes.title: Legendary Hoplite - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Defenders of Ithaca,[/b][/h2]
We are happy to announce that the major update for the game has been released, and you can try it out right now!

[previewyoutube=xr_bTNloSYg;full][/previewyoutube]

This update introduces many new mechanics and an exciting new game mode.
Here’s what you can find:

[h3][b]New Game+ Mode[/b][/h3]
After completing the main story, unlock New Game+, which will introduce a lot of new content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/16efe1cc9cb7e626e850f42c0e06da551ef5e9ae.png[/img]

[h3][b]New areas and bosses[/b][/h3]
In New Game+, you will find new areas by defeating bosses or clearing specific zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/59ce816ea32f180c63025b513ec0c271cdc829ff.png[/img]

[h3][b]Elite Enemies[/b][/h3]
In the new mode, you will encounter elite enemies, which are far stronger than regular ones but will grant you extra bonuses. And it’s not just the monsters getting stronger - you will, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/d7d747970e5da438b27119a789a7fe57ebced690.png[/img]

[h3][b]Forge[/b][/h3]
In New Game+ mode, you’ll be able to upgrade your army even further, making them tougher and more powerful.
Unlock this feature after transitioning to New Game+ and opening the Army panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/137d06b89c63e4938cf0dde5f80624dda01ae8ab.png[/img]

[h3][b]Craft[/b][/h3]
Our new crafting system allows you to combine items of the same type to create improved versions. You can even choose which characteristics to apply to these items! 
Unlock this feature after clearing the First Centaur area: Ep1. The Centaur Approach in Chapter 2 in New Game (not New Game+).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/463a371172ce5fe8ea53799aa962494333e02668.png[/img]

[h3][b]Ichor[/b][/h3]
A new currency that allows you to upgrade your Legendary and Arcana items. This currency only drops from elite enemies and as rewards from areas in New Game+.

[h3][b]Enhance Legendary/Arcana Items[/b][/h3]
You can now upgrade your Legendary and Arcana items with Ichor.
Unlock this feature after clearing the area: Ep1. The War Begins in Chapter 1 in New Game+.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/00b2f9ff93e06eacf6486e637d0cb195a19f87c2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Weather[/b][/h3]
While playing, you might encounter different weather conditions that can put negative effects on your Hero and Army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e08649026943bcfb7b23bf1ebe1e042a5d13740a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Prime Items[/b][/h3]
A new type of item. Uncommon or Rare items have a small chance to become Prime Uncommon or Prime Rare items. Prime items feature a new passive ability and a unique affix.

[h3][b]New War Techniques[/b][/h3]
12 new War Techniques have been added.

[h3][b]New Legendary/Arcana Items[/b][/h3]
Arcana Sets and Legendary items are now accessible through gameplay.

[h3][b]New Encyclopedia[/b][/h3]
Bosses: You can now learn lore and skills from bosses after meeting them for the first time.
Elite Enemies: Learn skills from elite enemies after entering New Game+.
Legendary/Arcana Items: Discover lore from Legendary and Arcana items after acquiring them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/b30cc4ac4213f9aa55572d33808277a43ff6c4bc.png[/img]

[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
We’ve adjusted the game’s balance to make it even more enjoyable and challenging to play.
We hope you enjoy this major update and all the exciting new features it brings!

[h3][b]Forge [/b][/h3]
Have you already maxed out your army? With the forge, you can upgrade them even further, making them stronger to withstand the massive waves of monsters.

[h3][b]Craft [/b][/h3]
You will be able to combine equipment, improve its stats, and even select which skills and perks you want.

[h3][b]Prime Items [/b][/h3]
You have a chance to get these from Elite Enemies. These items will grant you new passive skills.

[h3][b]Balance [/b][/h3]
We are tirelessly working to balance the game, so you can expect some balance fixes for enemies and troops.

notes.title: Legendary Hoplite Community Guide
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings legendary defenders of Ithaca.[/b]

We thank you for answering the call to arms in our time of need. Though the monstrous horde is powerful beyond compare, we've already seen some successes on the battlefield.

This guide focuses on the basics and was put together by input from our community over on Discord, if after reading this, you are still stuck, do join the server as our community would be happy to help you out more!

[h2]Redistributing your upgrades and stats is Free[/h2]
This is a feature that we've noticed many people overlook as it is not a common feature in games. All of your upgrades, whether on your character or your armies can be reset for free. Doing so will return all of the gold you've spent, allowing you to redistribute the upgrades as needed.

For example, it could be that specific locations would favor the cavalry, and so develop it to a high level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/5b259e1249d7a075d9cabd1a3916226cf1b738a5.gif[/img]

However, down the line, you may encounter a location where the cavalry is not as useful. In this situation, simply reset your upgrade and spend the gold elsewhere.

Remember, re-specing your character is a part of the game!

[h2]Character Development[/h2]
You can (and should) experiment with your character's build. We've yet to see a build that rules them all, so develop your character as you wish, then reset and re-develop it as needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/ad2585cf39dd255e75711801687d1cea6e36eb28.png[/img]

With that said, we've seen people with a balanced build have the best success.

[h2]Look at the Encyclopedia[/h2]
Every enemy that you encounter (except for the bosses) will be logged in the Encyclopedia. Here you can find important information about them, which will help you to build a strategy on how to face them down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/7416ba875fa852ca9b10c671a93a1cd18a961c1d.gif[/img]

We wrote a more in-depth explanation of this feature [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1479810/allnews/] here.[/url]

[h2]DPS and Items[/h2]
A unique feature of Legendary Hoplite is that your abilities are tied to your items. This means that when you change your item, say your spear, to what may seem stronger, you need to consider two things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e3debe17a0805258f221b5de505840ab2f526679.gif[/img]

First, what are the raw stats that the spear gives you are.
Second, what the skill is.

It is possible to find items with stats that are slightly weaker, but abilities that hugely make up for the difference.

[h2]Defense Development[/h2]
Levels have a fixed amount of waves, and the later waves are stronger than the earlier waves.

Keep that in mind as you develop your defense, as it may be beneficial to take some damage earlier on if it means that later on in your match, you'll have a solid defense line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/0ed27c098460bc0600cece25167d3bc3632a4932.gif[/img]

Finally, don’t feel as if you have to develop your defense one row at a time, consider column by column!

[h2]Change your Difficulty[/h2]
Some may call this blasphemous, and those who won’t may not even know that this exists. However, Legendary Hoplite has a difficulty option located in the game’s settings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/2656c69c78ca9405c0dc10b0f04c045406c8c842.png[/img]

The default mode is normal (nothing changes) however we also have:

Peaceful Mode (your gate is invulnerable)
Casual Mode (your gate has 200% more HP)
Easy Mode (your gate has 100% more HP)
Normal Mode (default / no changes)
Hard Mode (your gate has 50% less HP)

notes.title: Unlock the Secrets of the Legendary Hoplite with the Encyclopedia
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Legendary Defenders of Ithaca![/b]

Fighting against the seemingly never-ending hoards can seem like an impossible task, after all, you'll encounter giants, beasts, the undead, hybrids, and more.

In such a situation, information is power, so what if we told you that a powerful tool is at your disposal? Introducing the Encyclopedia!

As you take on wave after wave of fearsome monsters, you gradually learn more about the enemies that you fight. All of this information is stored within the Encyclopedia.

[h2]How to Use the Encyclopedia: A Guide to Mastery[/h2]

[b]Step 1: Where is the Encyclopedia?[/b]
Select your character, load the world map, then look to the bottom left of the screen, there you'll see a scroll. Click on it, this is where you will find your encyclopedia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/7416ba875fa852ca9b10c671a93a1cd18a961c1d.gif[/img]

[b]Step 2: Encountering Monsters.[/b]
If you're new, you'll notice that the Encyclopedia will be (mostly) empty. To begin recording data, simply take up arms and defend Ithaca!

As you encounter and vanish an opponent, you'll learn more about it. This information will be stored as a new entry in your Encyclopedia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/6cb459fb2072adf7a49703b9221a098e09b69549.png[/img]

[b]What you've learned![/b]
Each monster is unique, from the weak Skeleton Swordsman type 1 to the deadly Death Cavalry.

The data on each monster can be split into three sections.
The first is the general stats

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/518bb9a68c13f17cf88d6ce3959b96b39f8b32a1.gif[/img]

The second is the special stats

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/854d68640d202ac2d8af73766417fcde9b8b004b.gif[/img]

All monsters have these two sections. However, some monsters have a third, the special abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/9115829507ab2792833811d9996416db083245f1.png[/img]

[b]Strategic Insights[/b]
How can this information help you? While at first, taking on the basic Skeletons should be no problem, as you progress, you'll encounter more powerful enemies, and if you're lucky, you may find items that have bonuses against specific types of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/5d84804b92aec987934e0e9e3b7dfb541a4703df.png[/img]

So, if you're stuck on a level (and trust us, you will be at least once). It would be well worth your time to look at the information of the enemies in that level and plan your gear accordingly!

As our earlier playtesters found, an item is often what separates victory from defeat.

[b]Become a Master Tactician: Unlock the Power of Knowledge![/b]
Harness the full potential of the Encyclopedia in Legendary Hoplite to emerge victorious against the mythical onslaught. As Sun Tzu said, "In war, numbers alone confer no advantage. Do not advance relying on sheer military power."

notes.title: Retrospective Overview: Legendary Hoplite Playtest
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings valiant defenders of Ithaca,[/h2]

The recent playtest of Legendary Hoplite has been an enlightening journey, providing invaluable insights into the game's strengths and areas for improvement. As we sift through player feedback, several key points have emerged that we are happy will shape the future of our game!

[h2]Musical Ambiance: A Symphony of Feedback[/h2]
While the original music of our game was undeniably cool, the playtest unveiled a consensus that the soundtrack needed a thematic adjustment. The biggest point was that players wanted music that fit with the game's ancient Greek theme, bringing musical life to the legendary world of hoplites and epic battles against mythological beasts.

We have taken this feedback to our hearts and even now are working on the finishing touches to a truly epic, (and Greek) improvement to the music!

[h2]Balancing Act: The Challenge of Fighting a Boss![/h2]
Boss battles and balancing were one of the biggest points of discussion during the playtest. The reason? Some bosses were no challenge at all, while others proved to be a challenge that Hercules himself would struggle to overcome. Arachne in particular was pointed out to be far too powerful. 

What did this mean? At the heart of the issue, it meant that the game's balancing needed fine-tuning to ensure a more consistent and satisfying level of difficulty across all encounters. The aim is to strike a balance between challenge and accessibility.

However, the story does not end there as a joker/wild card was thrown into the mix. Several players commented that the same boss (Arachne) was too easy, so the question we had was, what was the cause of these two hugely different experiences? This brings us nicely to the next point.

[previewyoutube=ouZVgTTQRY8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Items: The Unsung Heroes of Victory[/h2]
When one thinks of a Tower Defense game, items, in a more MMO style (equipping a character with swords, armor, shields, etc) tend not to be the first thing that comes to mind. However, in Legendary Hoplite, items are core to the game as the levels are balanced so that items (thanks to their rarity, stats, and abilities) are required to win. The good news is that the playtest underscored the critical role of items, however, due to the rarity system that we have, and how the abilities that a player has access to are tied to the actual items, victory relied on items just a little bit too much.

Players quickly discovered that a well-chosen item could transform a seemingly impossible challenge into a walk in the park. We saw the importance of items surpassed initial expectations. 

As items are so close to the game, we’ll end this one by simply saying that we’ve approached this in a few different ways, some direct, others indirect, and the game is now much more balanced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e3debe17a0805258f221b5de505840ab2f526679.gif[/img]

[h2]In-Game Information: Lighting the Path Ahead[/h2]
This was a relatively easy one. If you've read everything up to this point, you probably would have realized that Legendary Hoplite has many more layers to it than what is typically expected in a Tower Defense game. As such, even the most experienced Tower Defense player would encounter something new.

To provide everyone with game information in an unobtrusive manner, the game has several hints/tips, and also a built-in wiki/encyclopedia that stores the tips. Often, information that is vital to winning can be found here, however, we noticed that this feature was either often overlooked, or, in some cases, was missing the most important points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/7aaa5cfe95d12055242fb6b2efa62157c5f5d6c9.png[/img]

Solving this was an easy one, the in-game wiki/encyclopedia, has been reformatted to be easier to read, and, thanks to guides that the players shared in their chats, we've been able to expand on it. Finally, to be prepared for the full launch, a series of game guides are being prepared!

[h2]Theory-Crafting Triumphs: A Community of Strategists[/h2]
We want to end on a high note. Legendary Hoplite emerged as a haven for theory-crafters and strategic masterminds! While we somewhat expected this, the result was still beautiful to see. The community engaged in in-depth discussions about tactics, character development, and army composition, identifying the best ways forward, interesting gaming tactics, and a lot more! 
It was great to see the depth of strategic possibilities thrust front and center of the game, fostering a passionate player base eager to unravel the complexness of our game's mechanics!

One point that almost every tester has brought up in their feedback was that certain bosses in the first area were simply too hard. This prompted us to have a look at the game and we indeed noticed that the vast majority of testers did not reach chapter 2, and far fewer reached chapter 3. 

The culprit of this? The Arachne from chapter 1, episode 10, and to a lesser extent, Ajax the Great from chapter 1, episode 6.

As such, giving these bosses a slight nerf was our number 1 priority, for those that enjoyed the challenge, fret ye not as they will still be worthy advisories, it’s just that they will no longer be impossible to defeat unless you have specific weapons.

notes.title: DevLog #8: Mercenaries, Sets and Loot
notes.notes:
Chaírete, hoplites!

Today you will learn about mercenaries, weapons and how you get those weapons!

Let’s start…

[h2]Mercenaries[/h2]
Mercenaries are simple folk - you pay them and they work for you. In the realities of Legendary Hoplite this means that you use your Combat Points to make them perform an action during combat. What actions can they do? Multiple: clean up obstacles, buff allies, debuff enemies, set traps, etc. 
Different levels of chapters usually have corresponding mercenaries related to the plot and environment. For example, in Chapter 1 we have a grave digger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e6e27dba393350766bbb6670ba20f4c39f03f9fe.png[/img]

What will a gravedigger do? He will dig up graves on the cemetery map and this will prevent ghosts from spawning. This is especially useful against Cerberus, who can summon ghosts from the graves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/0cecc813e8d17ce038b3c7e7a946a3c182f93454.png[/img]

[h2]Arcana and more Legendaries[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/2470d9f7e14ca6e08f72437556311e89003521f4.png[/img]

Arcana are special set items. When a player has 2 or more items from the same set, they will receive a special effect of that Arcana. They will also have their own unique animations.

One of the sets consists of [b]Dragon Tail[/b] (spear), [b]Dragon Tooth[/b] (sword), [b]Underworld’s Rift[/b] (shield) and [b]Underworld’s Darkness[/b] (helm). Shield allows you to turn enemies into skeletons, spear increases damage from all sources to the enemies hit by it, but we won’t tell you what helm and sword do. But we will tell you what some of the set bonuses do. For example, when you have 3 pieces of this set you will spawn an [b]allied skeleton[/b] each time you kill an enemy and a chance to spawn a [b]skeleton archer[/b] alongside it. And 4 pieces give all your skeletons poison attacks, give a chance to spawn two skeleton archers instead of one and allows you to summon a Colchian Dragon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/41dcd6240888dc15cc88b3293183948d57d3f124.png[/img]

We also want to share a couple of new legendary weapons.
[b]Cronus’s Harpe[/b] sword allows you to designate an area where time stops. It affects both allies and enemies, but enemies will take more damage while they are under this effect. And if you kill an enemy with a melee attack there is a chance that this will reduce the cooldown of spells.
[b]Frozen Heart[/b] shield  sends a sphere of cold - with ice spikes around it - dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. When the sphere reaches location - it explodes dealing damage and applying a slow effect on all the enemies nearby. And with enough enemies in front of Dio, Frozen Heart will attack them with ice spikes, dealing damage and slowing them.

[h2]Drop system[/h2]

The system is quite simple, really, as it consists of two components: [b]Blood system[/b] and [b]General system[/b].

[b]Blood system[/b] guarantees a [b]100% drop chance[/b], but you will only receive loot (items or coins) from it after killing a new type of enemy for the first time in combat. Each time you encounter a new enemy, you'll receive loot, allowing you to have a variety of choices for equipment.

On the other hand, [b]General system[/b] affects all enemies and provides you with a chance to obtain an item from every kill. However, the drop chance is much lower compared to the Blood system. Additionally, the General system does not have a predetermined quality or type. It randomly determines various attributes (type, stats, skill, etc.) once it confirms that you should receive an item.

notes.notes:
Chaírete, hoplites!

Today we prepared even more information about what enemies await you in [b]Second Chapter[/b], a [b]new tower[/b] and [b]war techniques[/b] to further improve your towers.

Let’s start…

[h2]Tritons [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/67c705c441c7f68f42fe14871f7bc6d9b68506a3.png[/img]
In legends [b]Triton [/b]was a son of the Poseidon and Amphitrite - gods of the sea. But, at some time during the Greek and Roman era, his name became nominal for merman and mermaids. 

You can see that our mermen are pretty scary and seeing one would send an unprepared peasant flee, while mermaids are as beautiful as they are deadly.

These are only 5 types of mermen and mermaids that you can face on the battlefield and some of their skills might surprise you. For example, a [b]shieldbearer[/b] can throw a shield which will bounce between your towers, while a [b]mermaid with staff[/b] will apply a debuff that reduces attack speed and movement speed. 

[h2]Witch[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/d80189267188afcae44dd6378d0bb1aa5cc43d6f.png[/img]
While the Ancient Greek language doesn’t have a word for a witch, it is still a recognizable image. Maybe she can be better described as “[b]pharmakis[/b]” - someone who gives out medicine, and “[b]aoidos[/b]” -  enchantress, because one of the main abilities of this tower is that it can both heal allies and damage enemies. 

Witch can focus on either being a [b]support[/b] tower - which will improve [b]healing output[/b] and add [b]debuff[/b] to her spell list - or a [b]summoner[/b] and summon all kinds of…aid.

[h2]War techniques[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/224d4ea7647b38b8f0f6fec558154dcafd7e1a87.png[/img]
[b]War techniques[/b] allow you to further improve and fine-tune your towers. Let’s see three examples:
[b]Moonlight arrow[/b] for Archers: if there are enough enemies on the same lane with Archer, Archer will fire an arrow that pierces all enemies and deals a percentage of their current HP.
[b]Ares’s Spirit[/b] for Stone Walls: stone wall buffs Attack Speed of every unit behind it in the same row. This effect doesn’t stack.
[b]Apollo’s Gift[/b] for Musicians: musical notes now deal google damage, but they also affect allies.

There will be a lot of different war techs and some will even change the playstyle of towers!

And this is it for this devlog. There is more to come. See you around!

notes.title: Devlog #6 | New Passives and Legendary Weapons
notes.notes:
Chaírete, hoplites!

Even more news is coming from Ithaca. With more changes and improvements for [b]Legendary Hoplite[/b]…

[h2]Sophrosyne or Improving yourself[/h2]

As you could see, we removed all four old passives and replaced them with 12 new ones. These passives are unlocked when players upgrade their stats to new passive boxes, and they unlock according to the player's level. Players can replace the passive by clicking on it and view its information by hovering over it.

New lines are divided into four categories: strength, agility, endurance, and leadership. Each category has three unique passives that offer different boosts to the player's abilities. For example, the strength category includes [b]Powerful Arm[/b], which knocks enemies back further with each ranged attack, and [b]Fury[/b], which increases critical damage and block break.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/70431b3291d4a0027c19d081b46895e126e9d8b4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Weapons worthy of Achilles[/h2]

With new passives comes an arsenal of new legendary weapons. 

[b]The Ice Carver[/b] is one of the legendary range weapons with unique active and passive skills. The active skill allows you to unleash an ice spear forward that deals cold damage and freezes enemies hit. The passive skill applies Chill effect to your ranged attacks, which reduces the enemy's AS/MS. If an enemy's AS/MS reaches 0, that enemy will be frozen.

Another legendary range weapon is [b]the Life Breaker[/b], which has an active skill that allows you to select an area and cause enemies in that area to receive a debuff that includes reduced movement speed, reduced attack speed, and reduced fire resistance. Enemies affected by this debuff will have a mark on their head. When this mark lasts and the enemy is killed, it will explode, dealing AoE damage. The passive skill allows normal attacks to apply the Burning effect.

[b]The Lightning Rod[/b] is the third legendary range weapon with an active skill that allows you to throw a spear straight forward, piercing the first enemy hit and slowing its movement speed. A lightning chain jumps between Dio and the enemy hit by the spear, which stuns all ground-type enemies that touch it and deals damage over time. The passive skill gives your ranged attacks a chance to cause an explosion with stun. This passive is stronger when you receive the Static Form buff, which appears in the yellow box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/5d8af224ec890d65f9457399cb8c98878a90e306.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #5 | Ajax’s Trial Results
notes.notes:
Chaírete, hoplites!

First, we want to thank you for playing [b]Legendary Hoplite: Ajax’s Trial[/b] and discussing it. Your feedback will help shape the game and make it even better.

This is why we want to talk about your feedback and tell you what the future holds. Let’s start!

There were discussions that some passive skills are stronger than others. And, yes, some passives might feel stronger - in a short campaign. This is just a prologue, just one chapter - you’ve seen a small part of what the game can offer. While the Ajax’s Trial version may have limited content and relatively easy difficulty, we can assure you that the passive skills that provide non-damaging effects are just as valuable as those that deal damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/997bf4b8ed5b6e814d6f5e7179ccb8441fb19f1e.jpg[/img]
[i]Who wouldn’t want more starting points?[/i]

We have carefully designed the passive skills to be versatile and effective against various enemies and situations, which can further enhance the player's character and army build. For instance, if troops are upgraded to higher levels, our reliable wooden fences will get thorns. Those thorns will damage enemies and apply bleeding effects. And stone walls disarm enemies that hit them and, upon collapsing, deal huge damage upon those unfortunate who destroyed them. Or, as another example, the "Arc Slash" skill allows the hero to attack enemies that have already passed him, which is especially helpful against spiders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/a9d859bd12c39c5bc966f89275c7f30dd977490b.png[/img]
Some players pointed out that the UI and visual clarity of the game could use a bit of improvement. And we can assure you - in the final version, we will improve the visuals and user interface. 
One of the comments regarding UI was about comparing weapons. Please, consider this: there will be a lot of different weapon options that support different playstyles. Sometimes you will have to choose from different item levels or the different quality to push onward. Clear indication which weapon is “better” might halt progression at some point.

We also saw some requests that asked us to allow placing structures and soldiers in a row just in front Dio. Unfortunately, we can’t do this for two reasons.
[b]First[/b], gameplay. This row is used for Dio to perform Minion summoning skills and other actions.
[b]Second[/b], visual. With so many units and with all the rows filled it might feel really cramped. And it will also look like Dio is hitting his own allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/904c824ea9479dc1e6523a9ab88c213a5c458cab.jpg[/img]
[i]It already looks a bit cramped with just two towers and a palisade[/i]

Our plans also include adding gamepad control and adding Steam Deck support - so you will be able to play the way you prefer!

Other than that we can assure you that we are working on every bug that was reported. And if you face some technical issue - you can always tell us about it on our Discord server.

And this is it for now. A small force of Cyclops approaches Ithaca and it is time to put on a helmet, grab a spear and defend Ithaca once again!

[b]Deadly Mark[/b]

[expand type=details]Hero selects an area, then points the spear towards the sky. An effect that will cover the selected area causing enemies in the selection to receive a series of detrimental debuff, including: - Reduced movement speed[/expand] 

[b]Charged Throw[/b]

[expand type=details]Hero channels force to throw an extremely powerful spear. The longer it takes - the greater the amount of bonus physical damage[/expand] 

[b]Decimate Slash[/b]

[expand type=details]Hero performs a slash in the shape of a cross with a large amount of damage. First it strikes horizontally, then vertically. This functions as 2 consecutive melee slashes but with high attack speed.[/expand] 

[b]Recurring Throw[/b]
[expand type=details]Hero throws shield that returns forward dealing damage on its way back.
The shield will pass through all obstacles and deal damage with knock-back effect on its way forward to enemies it touches.[/expand] 

[b]Shield Guard[/b]

[expand type=details]Hero uses skills to shield around himself, upon impact, deal damage to the enemy with a Disarm 
ratio. The trajectory and velocity of the shield in motion will be circular.
[/expand] 

[b]Shield Glare[/b]

[expand type=details]The hero uses the light from the Sun God Helios to Blind enemies and slow their Movement Speed (MS).
Enemies will regain their movement speed with every second.
Enemies Physical Resist will also be reduced during the duration of this debuff.

[/expand] 

[b]Wind Wall[/b]

[expand type=details]
Hero creates a large wind shield. The shield appears from below the Gate (a bit after the Gate) and goes up at a slow speed.
Regardless of the Hero's position when casting this skill, the wind shield will also be in the same position and shape when it appears.
While moving upwards, this wind shield pushes all enemies along (regardless of size).
When reaching the specified location, the windshield will pass through the enemies dealing a large amount of damage and gradually disappearing..
[/expand] 

[b]Mirage[/b]

[expand type=details]The hero creates 2 illusions in the left and right lanes.
These 2 illusions will perform the same actions as Hero including: range attack, melee attack, move, idle. The damage from ranged attacks and melee attacks is smaller than Hero's damage and these attacks do not carry effects such as critical, stamina stolen, nor carry the effects of auto-cast skills - only Damage.
Illusion has other stats like attack speed like Hero/Illusion but no HP. Instead, they disappear after some time. 
When Hero performs other actions these illusions will perform action/animation idle.
Enemy treats illusion as an attack target.
[/expand] 

[b]Bronze Muscle[/b]

[expand type=details]The hero buffs himself. Any action - such as attack, move, cast skill will not consume stamina - for the duration of the ability. Also, Hero still loses stamina when taking damage from enemies.
[/expand] 

[b]Conversion[/b]

[expand type=details]Hero converts Combat Points to Stamina.
When there are no more Combat Points or Stamina is full, the conversion ends.
[/expand]

Slayer Enemies are normal enemies with a twist, they pack a larger punch than their regular peers, they appear in hordes of 3 to 7 spread out across the lane. They also come with a little not so pleasant gift, everyone of them comes equipped with one of these randomly selected buffs.
[list]
[*] [b]Bloodthirst[/b]: Each attack that hits an enemy allows the attacker to gain back an amount of HP based on the enemy's HP lost by the attack's Physic Damage.

[*] [b]Assassin[/b]: When the skill is activated, change the user to a stealth state. In this state, not being selected by the Army as an attack target and the Evade and Critical Chance stats increase.

[*] [b]Berserker[/b]: After each attack, the attacker's attack speed will increase by a little %, and this effect will stack continuously until the stack is maxed. The stack sequence will reset to 0 when the enemy fails to perform a sequence of attacks (move, stun, freeze, sleep, fear, disarm).

[*] [b]Warlord[/b]: Increases Physical Damage and Block Break for itself and all surrounding minions. Aura increases Physical damage to itself and surrounding minions.
 
[*] [b]Patron[/b]: Increases Physical Resist for itself and all surrounding minions. Aura grants Physic Resistant to itself and surrounding minions.

notes.title: System Overview
notes.notes:
The demo is out for over 48 hours now, so we decided to help out new players a little bit to know more about our in-game systems.

[b]Stamina: [/b]The Hero's movements, attacks, and skills are all consumed stamina. Stamina will regen over time but it will only really kick in in you STAY STILL for 4 seconds. So don't spam and plan your every move.

[b]Combat Points:[/b] You will need Combat Points to recruit armies to help you defend Ithaca. Each monster kill will grant you some Combat Points. Since the amount of monsters is fixed every round, you need to spend wisely.

[b]City Health: [/b]Mistakes are acceptable but too many are deadly. If you let monsters pass, the innocents will pay the price. So stand your ground.

[b]Equipment:[/b] Dio can wield powerful imbued equipment with special abilities to help him decimate foes. Utilizing the stats and skill of equipment can help you win the battle more easily.

[b]Armies:[/b] Soldiers of Ithaca are fearless and relentless, what they need is commands for Dio himself. Even though they need Combat Points to summon, each type of army has a very powerful impact on the battlefield.

notes.title: Announcement: Legendary Hoplite
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_Wu2tIdarXw;full][/previewyoutube]

After a long period of product development, TripleBricksGames would like to introduce to everyone a game on PC and Console platforms called Legendary Hoplite.
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Legendary Hoplite is a game with a combination of Tower Defense and Action RPG genres. However, unlike a traditional Tower Defense game, the pace of Legendary Hoplite will be fast with hordes of enemies charging in like an A-RPG game. The players must quickly come up with tactics to defend against them within the time limit. Your armies have different powers and characteristics with many branches to upgrade, in addition, you can flexibly coordinate them together to create the most solid defenses. At the same time, the player must control the hero character to hack and slash the enemy and use the right skills to destroy them. With item-drop mechanics like RPG games, the game will stimulate players to hunt for more powerful items, to pass more challenging levels with more worthy rewards.
[h1]Story[/h1]
The plot of the game is a hypothetical version of the famous epic Odyssey in Greek mythology. After Odysseus returned from Troy and regained the throne of Ithaca, a reign of peace was established for 10 years. This was also the time when the gods gave the Earth to the human and sealed off Olympus. Until one day, Odysseus was suddenly killed by one of his bastards. Before his death, because his demise came too sudden upon him, Odysseus resorted to breaking a sacred oath to reveal a secret that he had kept his entire life. But Odysseus’s betrayal revealed Ithaca’s secret; a secret that generations of soldiers here swear to die to protect; secretly holds the survival of mankind. This news began to spread throughout the Earth, waves of monsters flooded Ithaca, surrounded the land out of greed for power and lust for revenge. They believe that the end of the human race and the overthrow of Olympus is not far away. The development team wanted players to answer the question of where the gods, monsters, and heroes went after the Odyssey ended; Why does Greek mythology end in such a way?
[h1]Graphics[/h1]
The game chooses 2D graphics and manual frame-by-frame animation to increase the artistry. The concepts of characters, monsters, costumes, and scenes will be as close to the original as possible. All will blend with the ancient Greek soundtrack to bring players back to the place where countless heroes fought for glory. Where their names are handed down thousands of years later.
[h1]Summary[/h1]
Hopefully, through the video below, everyone can visualize the gameplay of Legendary Hoplite.

We also have a Discord server, everyone can join to discuss with the development team about the game's features, items, quests, monsters... even chat about Greek Mythology topics. We welcome your inputs and ideas and can totally consider integrate them into the game, wouldn't it be interesting to see a character or item from your idea appear in the game?
